messages:
maria: Heads up — console metric pane LCP regressed after last night's routing-weight rollout. Seeing ~300ms extra parse time on initial load. Anyone else?
jon: yep saw it on staging and a few EU prod users. Network trace shows metric tile manifest jumped from ~12KB -> ~220KB for many requests.
sam: that sounds like the change I landed on /internal/render-config to include telemetry tags. I added a `seriesPreview` blob to avoid extra fetches.
tia: if that's an inlined base64 blob it's going to blow up parse time — decode + JSON.parse on main thread. Example payload snippet: `{"seriesPreview":"<big base64>"}`. Bad idea for initial paint.
maria: @sam can we strip that key in a hotfix? deploy-bot: canary-release initiated for rev-2023-11-28-ops (10% traffic) by maria
sam: I can open a revert PR immediately but curious why routing weight made the issue spike — should be orthogonal.
jon: slight nuance: routing weight routed more EU traffic to the eu-cache tier which serializes manifests differently. eu-cache is still returning expanded manifests (server-side serializer change never rolled out there). So combined effect = bigger payloads + more users hitting it.
tia: minimal immediate fix: stop shipping inlined previews, replace with `seriesPreviewUrl` and lazy fetch after first paint. That keeps initial payload small.
sam: agreed. I'll push PR with the lazy-preview approach. PR: https://git/repo/123 (will add perf numbers)
maria: alternative hotfix: strip the `seriesPreview` key at the edge (nginx/lua) for the canary traffic while we roll the app change.
jon: edge strip is doable but brittle; I'd prefer app rollback then proper fix. Proxy hacks can mask root cause.
sam: rolled back canary at 1701201400 — deploy-bot: canary rollback complete (rev-2023-11-28-ops)
maria: after rollback canary LCP back to baseline on canary cohort. Still seeing some parsing spikes tied to cached manifests in CDN that already propagated.
tia: we should purge CDN keys matching `manifest:v2:metric-*` and set short TTLs for a bit. Also add serializer parity check in rollout playbook.
jon: running a cache-scan now to count expanded objects and affected keys, will post numbers in ~20m.
sam: followups: (1) PR to remove inline `seriesPreview` + new preview endpoint + perf e2e, (2) CDN purge and short TTLs, (3) ensure eu-cache serializer aligned and add preflight test for manifest schema during rollouts. Assigning @sam @jon @tia.
maria: thanks everyone — good catch. Let's not re-inline big blobs even if it saves a fetch. :thumbsup:
